scope: Software engineering timing and memory characterization, not biological/FDR validation
fixture_mixture: 80% exact forward,10% missing anchors,10% N spacer; fixed deterministic pattern
order: Each repeat rotates the six methods by its repeat index; one subprocess at a time
metrics: process user+system CPU, external elapsed, loop CPU/wall, macOS peakRSS bytes including imports
comparison: Baseline and new strict use the same Python/environment/input/library. Count vectors/categories/non-timing baseline metrics must match; runtime is measured with variability, never claimed identical by construction.
memory_limit: No40M-read run; constant-read-memory architecture and observed prefix RSS only
